result:
Root cause: `strip_reminders` in `anthrouter/request_text.py` never trimmed outer whitespace, though its docstring says it does. Stripping the `<system-reminder>` block left a leading `\n`, so `startswith(ACTIVITY_LABEL_PREFIX)` failed. I added `.strip()` to its return value. The fix lives there, so every caller in `handlers.py` and `model_router.py` gets the trimmed text.

I ran your example through `is_activity_label_prompt` and it now returns `True`. I couldn't run the test suite because pytest isn't installed here, so the other callers are untested. Trimming could change classifier input or command matching in `model_router.py` and `handlers.py` if they relied on surrounding whitespace, though I didn't check that.
